ambient_events: The landing circle's marker lights breathe a slow, patient red.
The windsock snaps toward the bay and goes slack again.
A bay door runs down its track somewhere behind you and seals.
Wind scours straight across the open deck and off into the dark.
description: The crown of the tower: a circle of non-slip deck ringed in recessed landing lights, cantilevered past the parapet over four hundred feet of air. A lit windsock at the northern rail. Two glass-doored bays behind the pad, each big enough for a light rotorcraft. A refuelling point under a brass cover in the deck. Step in to the elevator.

flags.residents_only_deny: The panel by the pad door reads your hand, finds no residence attached to it, and stays shut. Somewhere below, a concierge is already deciding not to mention it.

window.description: A window with a bad seal, letting in a draught and a slice of whatever the weather is doing.
window.name: the window

name: Solenne Sky Pad
